mapper.insert: INSERT INTO games (started_at, completed_at, winner_player_id, total_rounds) VALUES (#{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{winnerPlayerId}, #{totalRounds})
INSERT INTO rounds (game_id, round_number, winner_player_id, points_scored, completed_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{roundNumber}, #{winnerPlayerId}, #{pointsScored}, #{completedAt})
INSERT INTO player_scores (game_id, player_id, final_score) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{playerId}, #{finalScore})
mapper.select: SELECT g.id AS game_id, g.completed_at, p.name AS winner_name, g.total_rounds FROM games g LEFT JOIN players p ON g.winner_player_id = p.id ORDER BY g.completed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT p.name AS player_name, COUNT(g.id) AS win_count FROM players p LEFT JOIN games g ON g.winner_player_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY win_count DESC, p.name ASC
SELECT p.name AS player_name, ps.final_score FROM player_scores ps JOIN players p ON ps.player_id = p.id ORDER BY ps.final_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
